### Lead Search Filters {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/lead-search-filters}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then start a new campaign or add leads to one.
- These are People filters. Local business search uses other filters (switch "People"/"Local" if shown).
- Within a filter, any match counts. Across filters, all must match. Include/Exclude tabs: Exclude wins.
- "Job titles": "Exact title match" (off by default), Exclude "Exact match", "Management level", "Department".
- "Location": "Match location on" Person or Company HQ. Counties unsupported.
- "Company keywords": "Match all included keywords" (off by default).
- "Customer type", "Business type", "Employees" (no Exclude; "Your own range" 1 to 1,000,000, "Add").
- Include only: "Technologies", "Hiring for", "Signals" ("Add signal", "Within" 7 days to 12 months, default 30, "Mentions"), "Revenue", "News", "Funding type", "Domains" (CSV upload).
- "Find similar companies": one website.
- "Company name": "Is any of" / "Is not any of".
- AI search: "Who do you want to email?" then "Find people", or "Pick filters myself". When adding leads: "Describe who you want to reach" then "Find leads with AI". If none given, fills Employees 1-10, 11-20, 21-50 and Location United States (replaces existing location). "We couldn't turn that into filters": rephrase or pick manually.
- "Only one person per company" (adding leads: "1 lead per company"): off for new campaigns, per search, duplicates checked by email. Turning on lowers the count.
- Counts drop: leads already in campaigns, unverified emails, recently contacted leads, narrow filters.
- API and MCP accept these filters.

### Lead Magnet Campaigns {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/lead-magnet-campaigns}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Campaigns", open a campaign, then click "Options".
- Not in the wizard. In "Campaign configuration", set "Campaign type" to "Lead Magnet", then "Save settings".
- "Lead Magnet Resource" card needs one resource. "Upload": PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, max 25 MB. "Video URL": Loom, YouTube or Vimeo, starting with `https`.
- "Name" optional (200 characters). Lead magnet context up to 1,000 characters. Buttons: "Save Resource", "Replace Resource", "Save Context".
- No activation without a resource. Removing it from an active campaign pauses it.
- On interested replies the AI SDR sends the resource, then follows up.
- "Settings" > "AI SDR Agent" > "The Lead Magnet Method": "Booking call type" (default Intro), "Follow-up delay" (1-30 days, default 3). Applies to all Lead Magnet campaigns.

### Campaign states {slug: cold-email-agent/concepts/campaign-states}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Campaigns"
- Draft: not sending. Open it, finish the wizard and click "Create Campaign", or review "Leads", "Sequences", "Options" and click "Launch campaign".
- Active: sends only in the configured hours, and only if sending inboxes are Active.
- Paused: by you, bounce protection, or the agent replacing a campaign. Data is kept and replies still arrive. Inbox and subscription charges continue. Click "Resume campaign".
- Completed: every lead finished the sequence. Not an error. "Resume campaign" works: add leads via "Import Leads" or "Add Leads" > "Lead Database". Or use Duplicate Campaign (three-dots menu). Past leads are not re-emailed.
- Archived: hidden; find via "Status" filter. No restore action: duplicate or contact support.
- Attention Needed: safety pause (bounce rate, provider safety state, AI flag, inbox/domain issue). Read the status reason or "AI Agent" tab. "Resume campaign" shows a confirmation. Never returns to Active automatically.

### Compliance {slug: cold-email-agent/concepts/compliance}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "AI SDR Inbox"; or "Settings" > "Cold Email Blocklist"
- Block an address: "Add to DNC" in "AI SDR Inbox", or "Settings" > "Cold Email Blocklist". AI SDR detects opt-out replies. Unsubscribe events move the lead to Unsubscribed and block it.
- Automatic: real sender name, SPF/DKIM/DMARC on platform-bought domains, hard bounces blocked, high bounce rates pause the campaign, out-of-office detected.

- Legal threat: stop, add to DNC, document, consult counsel. Compliance documents: contact support.

- Check spelling, every Routing Record and Verification Record added, Type, Name, Value exact; click "Verify Domain".
- Pending: wait, up to 48 hours.
- Authentication error: try default partner subdomain, then private window, then support.
- SSL warning: status "Provisioning" then "Active"; wait.
- Won't save: same type and name exists; don't delete blindly.
- Main site changed: use subdomain.
- Email stopped: restore MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC; use the free SPF checker.
- DNS missing: check nameservers.
- Cloudflare: "DNS only".
- Send support: domain, provider, Partner Panel and provider screenshots, error, time changed.
